title: Cross-functional activation blueprint for SDK & API: function-calling, structured streaming, and structured output samples
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create and coordinate a cross-functional launch blueprint and execution plan for the SDK + API surface that delivers function-calling, structured output, and streaming samples and docs. This ticket covers release notes coordination, sample localization, telemetry wiring, go-to-market comms, and a staged rollout plan with clear gating criteria.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized release notes draft approved by PM, Engineering, and Docs
SDK and API sample kits (JavaScript, Python, Go) with function-calling and streaming examples published to repo and linked in docs
Structured-output examples added to quickstarts and validated with integration tests
Telemetry and cost/latency instrumentation wired to console dashboards and validated in staging
Localization package for en-US and es-ES sample readmes completed
Stakeholder sign-off on rollout plan and rollback criteria
milestones: 2026-02-28: Release notes first draft and sample skeletons
2026-03-05: CI tests for streaming + function-calling samples green
communications_plan: Pre-announce to beta orgs 2 days before canary; public blog + release notes at GA; in-product guided tour for first-time users. Coordinate messaging with Growth and Partnerships for partner relays.
rollout_plan: Phase 0: Internal preview (docs+samples landing in staging) - internal-only
Phase 1: Beta canary to 5 pilot orgs (monitor latency, token cost, error rates) - 7 days
Phase 2: Gradual increase to 25% of new orgs with automatic rollback triggers
Phase 3: GA with full docs, samples, and public release notes
gating_criteria: End-to-end CI for samples passing for all supported SDKs
Average error rate for function-calling < 0.5% in canary
Token cost uplift within predicted bounds (<10% over baseline for equivalent workloads)
Telemetry dashboards populated and alerting configured
Legal sign-off on release notes and sample terms
release_notes_timeline: 2026-03-04: Engineering notes on compatibility and migration guidance
2026-03-25: Publish release notes and changelog entry
risks: Function-calling edge cases increase unexpected token usage in samples
Streaming SDK hook incompatibility with older client versions
Localization delays could stall non-en-US releases
Telemetry schema changes late in cycle require dashboard rewrites
mitigations: Add explicit token budget examples in samples and note cost implications
Maintain backward-compatible SDK adapters and include migration snippets
Ship en-US GA first and follow with localized readmes within 2 weeks
Version telemetry schema and add conversion layer in staging
open_questions: Do we enable function-calling by default for new keys or opt-in? (security/comms trade-off)
Should streaming examples show server-sent events or WebSocket approach as canonical?
Which legacy SDK versions do we claim support in release notes?
Do we bundle pre-built sample containers for quickstart or keep source-only?
qa_checklist: Samples run locally in JS/Python/Go without manual token edits
Integration tests cover structured output validation (schema assertions)
Streaming samples demonstrate reconnection and resume behavior
Release notes include migration section and code diffs
Docs quickstart renders correctly in dark/light console themes
